title: Burner Cannon
description: This adds the Burner Cannon from Sneak's Blueprint Project.
body:
# BurnerCannon

A Fabric mod that adds a placeable that fires explosive cannonballs. Load it with gunpowder, hand it a cannonball, and watch it rotate, aim, and fire with a full animation sequence and a satisfying boom.

---

## Features

- **Explosive cannonballs** — each shot creates a large explosion on impact.
- **Gunpowder charges** — load up to 4 gunpowder to increase range and power.
- **Pick up** — shift-right-click to break the cannon and get the item back

---

## How to Use

1. Craft and place the **Burner Cannon** item to spawn the cannon
2. Right-click with **Gunpowder** (up to 4 times) to load charges — more gunpowder = more range
3. Right-click with a **Cannon Ball** to fire — the cannon rotates toward where you are facing, aims, and launches
4. Shift-right-click the cannon to pick it back up
